sections.heading: Verka Mohali Dairy: The Rs 325 Crore Expansion
paragraphs: The Tribune reports that Milkfed Punjab's Verka plant in Phase 6, Mohali, is being expanded at a cost of Rs 325 crore, taking capacity from 6.5 lakh to 13.70 lakh litres a day over the next two years. Liquid milk handling goes up to 10 lakh litres a day, and 3.70 lakh litres a day is set aside for fermented products.

Fully automated units will add capacity for lassi, curd, clarified butter and butter, and a new line will pack butter chiplets in 10 g and 100 g sizes. Milkfed chairman Narinder Singh Shergill is quoted on the plan, which comes after Verka completed a Rs 160 crore fermented dairy facility for curd and lassi two years earlier.

sections.heading: Punjab Milk Supply Behind the Mohali Plant
paragraphs: DairyNews.today reported that members of the parliamentary Standing Committee on Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Food Processing visited the Verka plant at Mohali, looking at procurement, processing, quality control, packaging and the cold chain on site.

The report puts Punjab's output at about 384 lakh litres of milk a day, with the highest per capita availability in India at 1,318 grams a day, and says Milkfed supports more than 3.75 lakh producers under the Verka brand. Managing director Rahul Gupta said Verka is adding capacity, modernising and diversifying under Milkfed's Vision 2026, which aims to double production and processing. Doubling a plant's fermented-product output means extending curd and lassi pipework while the existing lines keep running.

sections.heading: Matching Tube Finish to Mohali Product Lines
paragraphs: Fermented curd and lassi, butter churning and chiplet packing, and clarified butter all leave fat and protein films that a rough bore holds on to, which is why we propose 316L to ASTM A270 with an SF4 electropolished surface for those sections. Each electropolished lot is supplied with its own Ra report and an EN 10204 3.1 certificate linked to the heat number.

Tanker reception bays, liquid milk transfer, chilled water and CIP return runs in a large liquid-milk plant can usually be built in 304L to SF1 or mill finish, saving the electropolished budget for the cultured and fat lines.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Mohali Enquiry
bullets: Section the tube is for: reception, liquid milk, curd and lassi, butter, ghee or CIP
Every OD and wall combination on the drawing, each with its total length in metres
Which runs are 316L SF4 electropolished and which are 304L SF1 or mill finish
The purchase standard, whether ASTM A270, A269 or ASME BPE, and your maximum Ra
Fittings to bundle with the tube, such as clamp ends, elbows, equal tees and reducers

sections.heading: Delivery to Mohali, the Chandigarh Tricity and Punjab
paragraphs: Mohali shipments are trucked from Mumbai with the ends of every electropolished length capped and the tube sleeved, and the written order confirmation states both the dispatch date and the transit. We PMI-verify each length ahead of loading and answer a complete enquiry with a quotation inside 24 hours.
